name: gitlogue
description_en: A cinematic Git commit replay tool for the terminal, turning your Git history into a living, animated story.
readme_excerpt: A cinematic Git commit replay tool for the terminal. Turn your Git history into a living, animated story — typing, syntax highlighting, file tree transitions. Watch commits unfold with realistic typing animations, syntax highlighting, and file tree transitions, transforming code changes into a visual experience.
